system.description: You draw silhouettes of horses or wolves in the dust and howl.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the mounts can take one hit each before vanishing.
outcomes.success: Spectral mounts appear for your party. They move at triple speed and do not tire. They vanish when the next day begins, or as soon as they take any damage.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the dust stays dust.
outcomes.ruin: The steeds come, and they stampede over you: you take d6 damage. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
